name: Michael Yen-Ting Lin
office: Walnut Valley Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 5 (Unexpired term ending December 1, 2028)

items.text: Michael Yen-Ting Lin was appointed to the Walnut Valley Water District Board for Division 5 in July 2026. He is a certified public accountant with experience in accounting, tax and finance, including at PwC. His campaign focuses on long-term water reliability, affordable rates, infrastructure investment and responsible management of ratepayer dollars. He says he wants to apply his financial expertise to water policy and fiscal oversight.
